sops.title: Standard check-in
steps: Greet the guest within 10 seconds, even if you're on the phone.
Ask for a physical driver's license or passport and the credit card in the same name. Scan the ID in IDGuru.
In PEP: Search Reservations > open the reservation > Check In. Work through Welcome, Verify Guest Details, Room Assignment and Payments.
Have the guest initial and sign the Reg. Card and fill in the vehicle box.
Room Keys panel > Make New Key. Hand over the key packet and parking pass (expires 1 day after check-out).
Tell them breakfast is 6–10 AM, the pool is open 10 AM–10 PM, the Wi-Fi network is [FILL: network name], and check-out is 11 AM.
Point to the elevator and wish them a good stay.
sops.script: "Welcome to the Hampton! Can I see your ID and the card you'd like on file?"
sops.flag: The ID or card doesn't match the guest, or PEP won't let you check in. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: check in, check-in, arriving guest, new guest, registration

sops.title: Preparing arrivals ahead of time
steps: Review the arrivals list and count how many of each room type you need.
Assign vacant clean rooms in PEP: open the reservation > Stay tab > Assign.
Read the comments and requests on each reservation and honor what you can.
Print the Reg. Cards and highlight the initials box, vehicle box and both signature lines.
Pre-make keys and paperclip the key packet to the matching Reg. Card.
Write a parking pass that expires 1 day after the check-out date and clip it on.
File each prepared card in the arrival bucket.
sops.kw: prepare arrivals, pre assign, pre-key, reg cards, arrival bucket

sops.title: Early check-in, room not ready
steps: Standard check-in is 3 PM. Check the housekeeping status for a clean, inspected room of the booked type.
If one is ready, check the guest in. Before 12 PM when occupancy is above 70%, there's a $50 early check-in fee.
PEP blocks check-in on a dirty room. Only mark it Ready for Guest after housekeeping has inspected it.
If nothing is ready, offer to hold their bags and take a cell number.
Ask housekeeping on WhatsApp to prioritize that room type, then text the guest when it's ready.
sops.script: "Your room isn't quite ready yet. I can hold your bags and text you the minute it is."
sops.flag: The guest is upset about waiting past 3 PM. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: early check in, check in early, room ready, room not ready, arrived early

sops.title: Guest arrives with no reservation (walk-in)
steps: Check tonight's availability in PEP (Availability in the sidebar).
Quote the best available rate, plus Honors, AAA or other discounts they qualify for.
Offer an upgrade if a better room type is open.
Ask for a physical driver's license or passport and a credit card in the same name. The guest must be 21 or older.
Dashboard > Walk In, then book and check in as normal.
sops.script: "We do have rooms tonight. Tonight's rate is $___. Are you a Hilton Honors member?"
sops.flag: The hotel is sold out or close to it. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: walk in, walk-in, no reservation, need a room, availability tonight

sops.title: Can't find the reservation
steps: In PEP: Search Reservations. Type "/" and search by guest name, confirmation number or room number.
Try other spellings, the last name only, and the name of whoever booked it.
Widen the dates and include the Canceled status.
Ask for the confirmation email. Check it's for Hampton Inn Overland Park on Metcalf, not another Hampton.
For a third-party booking, check the Expedia or Booking.com extranet.
sops.script: "Let me look a little further. Do you have your confirmation email handy?"
sops.flag: It's booked through a site you can't find, or the hotel has no room for them. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: cant find reservation, no reservation found, missing booking, confirmation number, wrong hotel

sops.title: Reservation is for the wrong date
steps: Confirm the dates on the guest's confirmation.
If they're early and it's a direct booking, change the dates in PEP: Stay tab > click the date > adjust NIGHTS > Save > Confirm.
If they missed their arrival, check the No Show / Late Cancel tile. Reinstate only works on the current business date.
Explain any rate change before you confirm.
Third-party bookings must be changed through the site they booked on.
sops.script: "It looks like the reservation is for a different night. Let me see what I can do."
sops.flag: A no-show was already charged and the guest wants it removed. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: wrong date, wrong day, booked wrong night, arrived early, arrived late

sops.title: Guest has no photo ID
steps: The guest must show a physical ID. Only a driver's license or passport is accepted.
Photos of an ID, expired IDs and other ID types are not accepted.
The only exception is a Hilton Honors Diamond member.
If they can't provide one, politely explain you can't check them in.
sops.script: "I'm sorry, we need a physical driver's license or passport to check in."
sops.flag: The guest becomes upset or insists. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: no id, no photo id, forgot id, lost id, id required

sops.title: Guest is under the minimum check-in age
steps: The minimum check-in age is 21.
Someone 21 or older must be staying and must be added as an additional guest (PEP: Guest tab > Additional Guests).
Scan that person's ID in IDGuru.
Sometimes the manager may allow an exception. Ask before you say yes.
sops.script: "Our policy requires a guest who is 21 or older on the reservation."
sops.flag: The guest asks for an exception. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: under 21, minimum age, too young, age requirement, 18 year old

sops.title: Name on the ID doesn't match the reservation
steps: Ask who made the reservation.
If someone else booked it, the guest staying must still show their own ID.
If someone else is paying, the cardholder must complete a Canary credit card authorization form.
Update the reservation to the actual guest's name before you check in.
sops.script: "Who made the reservation for you? I just need to match it to your ID."
sops.flag: You think the card or booking may be fraudulent. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: name doesnt match, wrong name, booked by someone else, different name

sops.title: Guest has no credit card
steps: The guest must have a valid credit card in their name that matches their ID.
If they don't, the cardholder (who is not present) must fill out a Canary credit authorization form.
The hotel is cashless. Cash can't be used for the room or the deposit.
Don't check in until payment is secured.
sops.script: "We need a card in your name. If someone else is paying, I can send them a quick authorization form."
sops.flag: The guest can't provide any card. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: no credit card, no card, pay with cash, cash only, debit

sops.title: Card declines at check-in
steps: Say it quietly: "That card didn't go through."
Any other card they try must be in the name on their ID.
No check-in is allowed until payment is collected.
If the guest is part of a group, reach out to the sales director.
sops.script: "That card didn't go through. Do you have another card in your name we could try?"
sops.flag: The guest has no other card or becomes upset. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: card declined, card declines, payment failed, card not working

sops.title: Local resident wants a room
steps: There are no extra restrictions for local residents.
The guest must be 21 or older with a physical ID and a card in their name.
Check them in as normal.
sops.kw: local resident, local guest, lives nearby, local address

sops.title: Guest wants to see the room first
steps: This is allowed only if another manager or team member can watch the desk or escort the guest.
Never hand the guest a key on their own.
Walk them up, show the room, and walk back down together.
sops.script: "I'd be happy to show you. Let me get someone to cover the desk."
sops.kw: see the room, look at room, view room, show room

sops.title: Room type requested isn't available
steps: Check PEP for any room of that type that can be cleaned quickly.
Offer a comparable room type, explaining the difference.
If you move them to a better type at no charge, use Room Type > Complimentary Upgrade.
Note the request in Stay Remarks for the next night if they're staying longer.
sops.script: "We don't have that room type available tonight, but I can offer you ___."
sops.flag: The guest refuses every option. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: room type not available, wanted king, wanted two queens, sold out room type

sops.title: Guest asks for an upgrade
steps: Check what's available for every night of the stay.
Quote the paid upgrade rate for the better room.
Honors Gold and Diamond members get space-available upgrades per Hilton standard. Offer one when available.
In PEP: Stay tab > Room Type > Next (charged) or Complimentary Upgrade.
sops.script: "I can upgrade you to a ___ for $___ more per night."
sops.kw: upgrade, better room, suite, bigger room

sops.title: Late arrival after the audit has run
steps: Look for the reservation on the No Show / Late Cancel tile.
If the check-in date is today's business date, open it > Reinstate > Confirm.
If not, rebook it with Actions > Copy Reservation from the No Show tile.
Check in as normal and make sure the night is posted correctly.
sops.flag: The guest was charged a no-show and wants it removed. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: late arrival, arrived after audit, no show showed up, reinstate

sops.title: Arrival calls at 9 PM
steps: Around 9 PM, call every guest still in arrivals.
Ask for an estimated time of arrival.
Note each ETA in Quore so night audit knows who's coming and whether to hold the audit.
sops.script: "Hi, this is the Hampton Inn Overland Park. We're looking forward to seeing you tonight. Do you know about what time you'll arrive?"
sops.kw: arrival calls, eta, call arrivals, 9pm calls

sops.title: Calling HLD guests around 5 PM
steps: Around 5 PM, pull up reservations on hold (HLD) without a card.
Call each guest and ask for a card to guarantee the room, or send a Canary link.
Note the result on the reservation.
sops.script: "I'm calling to guarantee your reservation for tonight. Could I get a card for the room?"
sops.kw: hld, hold reservations, guarantee, no card on file, 5pm calls

sops.title: Guest arrives and the hotel is oversold
steps: Reach out to the MOD before you tell the guest anything.
Find a nearby hotel with availability.
Follow the walk procedure the MOD gives you: book the other hotel and arrange how the guest gets there.
Apologize sincerely and log it in Quore.
sops.script: "I'm very sorry. We're full tonight, and I've arranged a room for you nearby."
sops.flag: Always: call {AGM} before walking any guest.
sops.kw: oversold, overbooked, walk guest, no rooms left, sold out

sops.title: Digital Key guest
steps: Digital Key guests check in and get their key in the Hilton Honors app.
If the key isn't working, reissue the digital key.
Ask the guest to check for pending Hilton Honors app updates.
If it still fails, make a physical key after checking ID.
sops.script: "Let me reissue your digital key. Could you also check the Honors app for an update?"
sops.kw: digital key, phone key, app key, honors app key not working

sops.title: Multiple rooms for one party
steps: Book together with New Booking and set the number of rooms. Room 1's guarantee copies to the others.
If booked separately, link them: Actions > Linked Reservations > Link New Reservation.
Assign rooms near each other when possible.
If one card pays for all, set that up before check-in.
sops.kw: multiple rooms, two rooms, family rooms, rooms together, link reservations

sops.title: Guest checking in for someone else
steps: Only guests on the reservation can get keys.
The person checking in must show their own ID and be added to the reservation.
If the person paying isn't there, they must complete a Canary credit authorization form.
sops.script: "I can help as soon as you're added to the reservation."
sops.kw: check in for someone, picking up keys for, someone else's room

sops.title: VIP or GM-flagged arrival
steps: Check reservation remarks and Quore for VIP notes before the guest arrives.
Pre-assign the best available room of their type and have it inspected.
Set up any welcome amenity the manager requested.
Let {AGM} know when the guest arrives.
sops.kw: vip, special guest, owner, gm guest

sops.title: Standard check-out
steps: In PEP: Departures > open the reservation > Folio tab.
Review the charges with the guest. The balance must be $0.00.
Check Out > check "All folios are balanced" > Confirm Check Out.
Offer to email the folio.
Ask how their stay was and thank them.
sops.script: "How was everything with your stay? I'll email your receipt."
sops.flag: The guest disputes a charge you can't fix. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: check out, checkout, leaving, departure, receipt

sops.title: Express or Digital Key check-out
steps: Guests can leave keys in the room; the folio is emailed.
To set it up: reservation Guest tab > Guest Actions > Express Check Out on.
Departures > Express Check-Out. Everything on the Qualified tab is ticked by default; untick anyone you don't mean to check out > Confirm.
Fix anything on the Not Qualified tab by hand (balances, refunds due).
sops.kw: express checkout, express check out, digital checkout, left keys in room

sops.title: Vacant rooms during check-out
steps: As each room becomes vacant, pull its Reg. Card from the bucket and file it in the checked-out tray.
Text the housekeeping WhatsApp group which rooms are vacant.
Print a vacant clean list and match it to today's arrivals.
sops.kw: vacant rooms, checked out rooms, tell housekeeping, whatsapp vacant

sops.title: Late checkout request
steps: Check-out is 11 AM.
Look at tonight's occupancy and whether housekeeping can still finish every room on time. Reach out to housekeeping before you approve.
Limit how many late checkouts you give. With teams, if one member gets it the rest will ask too.
After 12 PM, a full night is charged unless a manager waives it.
Update the departure time in PEP and tell housekeeping.
sops.script: "I can give you until ___. After 12 PM we do have to charge a full night."
sops.flag: The guest wants past 12 PM without the charge. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: late check out, late checkout, stay later, extend checkout, leave later

sops.title: Departures still in house after 11:15
steps: After 11:15 AM, call each room still on the departures list.
If there's no answer, knock with a second team member and announce yourself.
If they need more time, follow the late checkout rule: full night after 12 PM unless a manager waives it.
If the room is empty but belongings remain, tell {AGM} before anything is packed up.
sops.script: "Good morning, this is the front desk. Check-out was 11. Will you be needing a few more minutes?"
sops.flag: Belongings are left behind or the guest won't leave. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: still in room, past checkout, overstay, didnt check out

sops.title: Guest wants to leave early
steps: Check the rate type. Prepaid and advance purchase rates usually can't be refunded.
The current night can be refunded if they check out before 11 AM.
In PEP: Stay tab > change the Check-Out Date > Confirm > Confirm.
Actions > Early Check-Out Flow. Waiving the early departure fee needs a manager override.
All refunds go to a manager first.
sops.script: "I can check you out today. Let me see what applies to your rate."
sops.flag: The guest wants the fee waived or a refund. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: leave early, early departure, checking out early, cut stay short

sops.title: Guest wants to extend the stay
steps: Check availability for the added nights.
Direct booking: Stay tab > Check Out date > add NIGHTS > Save > read the new cost > Confirm.
OTA booking: create a separate reservation. Actions > Copy Reservation, pick the new dates and rate.
Collect payment from the guest and insert the payment into the terminal.
Make new keys with the new departure date.
sops.script: "I can add those nights. The rate for the extra nights is $___."
sops.kw: extend stay, stay longer, another night, extra night, add nights

sops.title: Guest disputes a charge on the folio
steps: Open the Folio tab and find the charge.
If it's clearly a posting error, fix it: select the charge > Adjust > Adjustment Code > Remarks > Confirm.
If it's a fee the guest disagrees with (smoking, damage, pet), don't remove it yourself.
Log what happened in Quore.
sops.script: "Let me take a look at that charge with you."
sops.flag: The guest disputes a fee or asks for money back. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: dispute charge, wrong charge, didnt order, overcharged, folio error

sops.title: Guest needs a receipt after leaving
steps: Find the reservation and check for an email on file.
Confirm with the guest that the email is correct.
Folio tab > Email All Folios (Net View or Detailed View) > Send.
OTA prepaid reservations: only the incidental folio may be emailed, not the room charges.
Never read card numbers over the phone.
sops.script: "I'll email that to you right now. Can you confirm your email address?"
sops.kw: receipt, folio, email receipt, invoice, copy of bill

sops.title: Guest skipped (left without paying)
steps: Confirm the room is empty and the guest is gone.
Charge the balance to the card on file: Folio tab > Payment.
Note any damages with photos.
Write an incident report.
sops.kw: skipped, skip, left without paying, didnt pay, walkout

sops.title: Damage or smoking found after check-out
steps: Get photos from housekeeping and maintenance notes.
Post the fee: Folio tab > Charge. The smoking fee is $450.
Email the guest the photos of the damages.
Mark the guest DNR in PEP (DNR tab > DNR Code > remarks > Mark DNR) and in ID Guru.
sops.flag: Before posting any damage charge, check with {AGM}.
sops.kw: damage, smoking, smoked in room, broken, stained, smoke fee

sops.title: Lost and found
steps: Log the item in PEP: More > Lost and Found > Add Found Item.
Store it securely with the date and room number.
Reach out to the guest and see if they'd like it shipped back.
Wallets, jewelry, electronics and IDs go to a manager to store.
sops.script: "We found your ___. Would you like us to ship it to you?"
sops.kw: lost and found, left behind, forgot item, lost item, found item

sops.title: Day use / same-day check-out
steps: Create a standard one-night reservation.
Check the guest in.
Stay tab > click the Departure date > select today > set NIGHTS to zero > Save > Confirm.
Make sure the arrival and departure dates match and it shows on today's departures.
sops.kw: day use, day room, same day, few hours

sops.title: Taking a reservation by phone
steps: Get the arrival and departure dates, number of guests and preferred room type.
Ask for their Hilton Honors number.
Quote the rate and the cancellation policy.
In PEP: Dashboard > New Booking > dates and guests > name > Room Type and Rate Plan > Guarantee Type > Done > Book.
Send the confirmation: Actions > Review Booking > Send Confirmation Letter.
sops.script: "Thank you for calling the Hampton Inn Overland Park. What dates are you looking for?"
sops.kw: phone reservation, book a room, make reservation, reservation by phone

sops.title: Quoting rates
steps: Start with the best available rate.
Ask if they're an Honors member or qualify for AAA, AARP, government or military rates.
Quote the rate with taxes so there are no surprises.
Rates should match hilton.com.
sops.script: "Tonight's best rate is $___ plus tax. Do you have any memberships like AAA?"

sops.title: Guest says it's cheaper online
steps: Ask where they saw it and for which dates and room type.
If it's hilton.com, book that rate.
If it's a third-party site, explain the guest can submit a Hilton price match claim online. [CHECK: current Hilton price match process]
Remind them that booking direct earns Honors points.
sops.script: "Booking with us directly gets you Honors points, and Hilton will match a lower price."
sops.kw: cheaper online, price match, expedia cheaper, better rate online

sops.title: Discount rate ID check
steps: AAA, AARP, government and military rates need proof at check-in.
Ask for the membership card or government or military ID.
If they can't show it, change the reservation to the best available rate.
sops.script: "This rate needs your AAA card at check-in. Do you have it with you?"
sops.kw: aaa, aarp, military rate, government rate, discount id

sops.title: Changing a reservation
steps: Find it with Search Reservations.
Dates: Stay tab > click the date > adjust NIGHTS > Save > read the cost change > Confirm.
Room type: Stay tab > Room Type > pick it > Keep Current Rate, Use New Rate or Rate Override.
Third-party bookings must be changed through the site they booked on.
sops.kw: change reservation, modify booking, change dates, change room type

sops.title: Cancelling a reservation
steps: Check the cancellation policy for that rate.
If a refund is owed, it goes to a manager first, and must be done before cancelling.
Cancel Reservation > YES > Confirm > choose a reason > Done.
Give the guest the cancellation number.
If linked reservations are involved, read the prompt: cancel one, or all linked.
sops.script: "Your reservation is cancelled. Here is your cancellation number."
sops.flag: The guest wants a penalty waived. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: cancel, cancellation, cancel reservation

sops.title: Advance purchase / non-refundable rates
steps: These rates are prepaid and can't be refunded or changed.
Check the rate on the reservation before promising anything.
Exceptions are a manager decision.
sops.script: "This was booked at a non-refundable rate, so I'm not able to change it."
sops.flag: The guest asks for an exception. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: advance purchase, non refundable, prepaid, cant cancel

sops.title: No-shows
steps: At night audit, anyone still in arrivals is charged one night to the card on file.
If the charge goes through, the booking becomes a no-show. If it fails, it's cancelled.
If the guest arrives the same business day, Reinstate from the No Show / Late Cancel tile.
sops.flag: A guest disputes a no-show charge. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: no show, no-show, didnt show, charged for no show

sops.title: Watching availability to avoid overselling

Watch room types that are close to selling out.
Tell {AGM} if any night looks oversold.
sops.kw: availability, oversell, overbooked, sold out

Call any guest whose card failed.
Keep a waitlist for walk-ins and callers.
Allow Overbooking only with manager approval.
If you have to walk a guest, follow the walk procedure (CI-19).
sops.flag: Before overbooking or walking anyone. Call {AGM}.
sops.kw: sold out, full, no availability, oversold night

sops.title: Long-stay guests (7+ nights)
